messages.author: 0ee8ae7c0d185529
messages.subject: Another blavInspect issue
parts:
Greetings,

I am using blavInspect to obtain latent variable means (in a growth curve modeling framework).  The line generating the means is

lvmeansMathBoys <- blavInspect(fitMathBoys, "lvmeans")

which should give the intercept and slope.  However, when I look at lvmeansMathBoys, I find that about halfway down, the columns switch.  Here is what it looks like

[22,] 279.7861743 285.9212062
[23,] 268.4985774 278.89096887 
[24,] 281.1468074 285.9491967
[25,] 283.7256738 282.1020356
[26,] 269.8501308 284.1327065
[27,] 283.4210721   1.7872870
[28,]   0.5904732   2.2695248
[29,]   2.9580829   1.8216772
[30,]   1.5875472   0.6985985
[31,]   1.0508855   4.5301369
[32,]   1.1334278   1.6660429
[33,]   2.0867198   2.9252998


The first column is correct until row 28 and the second column is incorrect until row 27.  Any thoughts as to what is happening?

Thanks!

David

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Another blavInspect issue
parts:
Hi David,

I think this issue was already discussed here:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/blavaan/_AfnGjLpFnk

and it should already be fixed in the development version from my website. But note: in the development version, the Stan approach is default and is much faster/efficient than before. But the installation is also heavier (requires compilation). Here is the install command:

install.packages("blavaan", repos="http://faculty.missouri.edu/~merklee", type="source")

This should be released to CRAN soon.

Ed

messages.subject: Re: Another blavInspect issue
parts:
Thanks for the report. This is the part of the install that is
"heavier" than before. It is going to cause problems for some people,
but I think that the gain in speed will be worth it.

In your case, I think you are missing some system tools that are
needed to compile stan models. Try going to the terminal (outside of
R) and typing

xcode-select --install

More details here:

https://discourse.mc-stan.org/t/error-in-compilecode-while-installing-mac/4066

Ed
